data.one_liner: Show overlay windows or notification bubbles over all other apps with callback events.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin to show a Truecaller-like overlay window or notification bubble over all other apps. Supports Android bubble APIs, overlay permissions, isolate communication, and passing custom Flutter UI inside the overlay.
use_when: You need to build a floating overlay window like a caller ID app.
You want to display notification bubbles or overlay views on Android above other applications.
avoid_when: You only need standard in-app widgets or local notifications.
You require robust, fully-featured iOS overlay support (iOS help needed).
strengths: Supports custom Flutter UI inside the overlay window via entry points.
Handles Android 11+ bubble APIs and older overlay draw permissions automatically.
weaknesses: iOS support is limited/displays as a notification in the notification center.
Requires platform-specific configuration and permissions like SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW.
data.setup_notes: Requires Android permissions such as SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, and WAKE_LOCK in the AndroidManifest.xml, and a dedicated entry point function annotated with @pragma('vm:entry-point').
